title: Reading skew

choices: Highly right-skewed; the median is the better summary of a typical repair
Left-skewed, because the median is smaller
Moderately right-skewed; the mean is the better summary
explanations: Skew is named after the tail; the mean is pulled right by long repairs.
The skew factor 1.6 is far above 0.5, and mean ≫ median.
Above 1 is highly skewed, and skew makes the median safer.

hints: Mean > median: which way is the tail?
Which center resists a long tail?
solution: Mean > median and skew 1.6 > 1: highly right-skewed. The median isn't pulled by the long repairs.
